compiled_state.title: test_push_induced_dismissal_resets_poll_window: asserts log signal -> wall-clock counter reset unverified
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

`test_push_induced_dismissal_resets_poll_window` in tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh asserts on the `POLL_WINDOW_RESET` log signal but does not verify the wall-clock counter (`_start`) was actually reset. A regression where the implementation logs the signal but forgets to reset `_start` would still pass.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [8] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — log-signal assertion is the canonical behavioral testing pattern, but coupling the test to a single-side-effect signal is fragile.

## Suggested Fix

Either (a) add a second assertion that the wall-clock cap does not fire even after sufficient elapsed time post-reset (behavioral proof of reset), or (b) accept current coverage and document the trade-off in the test header.
